_readme.units: metres unless a key says otherwise (deg, in, mm, bar, count, pct)
_readme.axes: x aft from nose tip (x=0); y lateral, + = starboard (right); z up from ground at MRW forward-CG static. Airbus X-datum: nose tip is at about Airbus X=2.49 m (NLG axle Airbus X=7.561 is 5.07 m behind the nose).
_readme.q: Each group has q = default quality (measured = number printed in a source; estimated = scaled from a drawing/photo or derived). 'est' lists keys that differ from the group default and says how they were obtained. Sub-objects with their own q override.
_readme.src: Codes point to SOURCES.md (S1, S2 ...). S1 = Airbus A320 Aircraft Characteristics (AC) Rev Jul 01/26; page numbers are PDF pages.
_readme.drawing_scale_note: Silhouettes vectorised from AC p48 (side) and p49 (plan). Plan drawing gives span 35.46 vs real 35.80 (about 1% short); side gives height 11.78 above wheel bottoms. Multiply plan y by 1.0096 if an exact span match is wanted.

est.span_without_sharklets_approx: 35.80 - 2 x 0.85 sharklet lateral reach, plan fig p49
est.cabin_floor_height_above_ground_approx: door-1 sill 3.38 at MRW fwd CG; floor top about at sill (sill 0.03 below ref)

src: S1 p48 side view fig 2-2-0-991-009 sheet 1
outline.how: Largest filled vector path of the Airbus drawing, extracted with PyMuPDF, beziers flattened, Douglas-Peucker 0.03 m, scaled so length = 37.57. side: [x aft, z above wheel bottoms]. plan: [x aft, y signed] (outline includes wing, HTP, nacelles).

stations_0p25m.note: per x station: side_z_cuts = silhouette z crossings (bottom, top, plus fin/engine/gear where present); plan_y_cuts = |y| crossings

fuselage_sections_summary.note: bottom z / top z / half-width at selected x

est.cant_deg_approx: atan(height 2.43 / ~0.6 lateral offset) from front view; not given in source

slats.note: slat 1 inboard of pylon about y 4.3-6.4; slats 2-5 outboard; A-G are spanwise check points of fig on p67 (order inboard to outboard assumed)

lights.strobes: wingtip/sharklet trailing edge both sides + tailcone white
lights.logo_lights: HTP upper surface both sides lighting fin
lights.landing_lights: wing root lower surface, y about 2.5
lights.numbering_fig: S1 fig 2-10-0-991-009 shows lights 1-13 placed on drawing (no dimensions)

est.dihedral_deg: commonly quoted figure, no primary source found
est.slats: joints from plan p49; heights measured p67
est.spoilers: joints from plan p49; A-G stations scaled from front view p66 by half track (0.05496 m/pt); heights measured
est.aileron: span from plan p49, chord estimated, stations front view; heights measured
est.lights: positions from lights fig and photos

tail.how: all xy/xz coordinates vectorised from side p48 / plan p49; chords from hinge lines; HTP dihedral from front view

est.pylon: scaled from side view p48 and photos; no dimensions in sources

NLG_doors.note: fwd pair hinged at keel edges, closed on ground; aft doors on strut, open

avionics_hatch.position: belly centreline just aft of NLG bay

service.potable_water_panel: lower aft fuselage right, about x 27
service.waste_panel: lower aft fuselage left, about x 28
service.pitot_static: both sides of nose, about x 2.5-3.2

windows.note: vectorised from p48; 14.51/15.37 sit in the overwing exits; 20.74/21.9 uncertain

est.cabin_x_range_approx: door 1 to aft galley from AC layout drawing

cockpit.note: Airbus publishes no cockpit interior dimensions. Values estimated from standards (DZUS/ARINC), simulator-builder data and photos. Coordinates: x from nose, y +right, z above cockpit floor unless _ground.

pilot_eye.note: y=0.53 dimension in front view taken as eye lateral offset (ambiguous); z derived from 20 deg over-nose geometry

display_units.layout: main panel: Capt PFD, Capt ND, ECAM upper E/WD (centre), F/O ND, F/O PFD; ECAM lower SD below E/WD

glareshield.pcb_note: MobiFlight PCB bboxes 1040x377.5 and 635x382.5 EasyEDA units, assumed 10 mil/unit
glareshield.warning_lights: master warning/caution and autoland each side

pedestal.aft_pedestal: ATC/TCAS, WX radar, rudder trim, cockpit door, printer, parking brake
pedestal.panel_example: hobby A320 aft-pedestal panel 146 x 175.5 x 6 mm (S10)

sections: fwd: ADIRS, flight control, EVAC, GPWS, RCDR, oxygen, calls, rain repellent, wipers
centre: fire, hydraulic, fuel, electrical, air cond, anti-ice, cabin press, ext lights, APU, signs, int lights

side_consoles.items: sidestick, tiller (outboard), tray table, oxygen mask stowage

datums_and_frames.note: frame x positions only valid in constant section using 0.533 m pitch
